step.label: RANGE — clockwise
step.action: Turn RANGE slowly clockwise through several clicks. Pause briefly between clicks. Keep turning only in that direction.

step.label: RANGE — counter-clockwise
step.action: Turn RANGE slowly counter-clockwise through several clicks. Pause briefly between clicks. Keep turning only in that direction.

step.label: MINS — one notch left / decrease
step.action: Move the inner MINS knob to its FIRST notch left / decrease, hold for a second, then release. Repeat twice. Do not push past the notch.

step.label: MINS — past the notch left / decrease
step.action: Move the inner MINS knob PAST the first notch left / decrease, hold for two seconds, then release. Repeat once.

step.label: MINS — one notch right / increase
step.action: Move the inner MINS knob to its FIRST notch right / increase, hold for a second, then release. Repeat twice. Do not push past the notch.

step.label: MINS — past the notch right / increase
step.action: Move the inner MINS knob PAST the first notch right / increase, hold for two seconds, then release. Repeat once.
